items.expected: Preserve full host connectivity and the correct number/charge of guests. Document counterion/solvent approximations and compare observables at defined geometry/state/conditions. Any aggregate classification or optical causal claim must follow from supporting evidence, not a geometric label alone. Distinguish a true single guest from a two-guest observable.

Produce quantitative molecular-association evidence for the specified host/guest compositions with auditable structures, charge and method. Link the chosen structural/optical quantities to the actual question and measurement conditions.

items.statement: Evidence that distinguishes the claimed explanation
items.expected: Use a defensible investigation to show what aspects of association explain the observations and distinguish plausible alternatives. No deletion protocol, orientation list, exciton formula or minimum number of searches is mandatory.

Assess reliability of inferred association and optical interpretation, including environmental/model limitations relevant to the claims. A demonstrated ambiguity in packing or mechanism can earn credit when supported quantitatively.
